diferenciador: Lo que hace distinta a esta casa no es una amenidad, es lo que no hay: ruido, prisa, gente de paso. Se renta completa, así que la alberca, la terraza y la playa son de quien llegó y de nadie más.
Y está el mar, que aquí no es paisaje sino despensa. Los pescadores salen de madrugada y regresan con lo del día. De la ola a la cacerola, como se dice en el pueblo.

en.resumen: A whole house on the water, with a private pool and direct beach access. It rents whole, one booking at a time.
en.historia: This house started as a way back. I returned to Chimo to build the house I wanted here: the pool, the clay-tile roof, the outdoor fireplace, and the mountain and the ocean framed in the same window. We open it when we are away, whole, one booking at a time.

diferenciador: What makes this house different is not an amenity, it is what isn't here: noise, hurry, people passing through. It rents whole, so the pool, the terrace and the beach belong to whoever arrived and to nobody else.
And there is the ocean, which here is not scenery but a pantry. The fishermen leave before dawn and come back with the day's catch. From the wave to the pan, as they say in the village.
